statement: For each non-null field of length at most three over a, comma, double quote, CR and LF, both revisions of StringEscapeUtils.escapeCsv return the same UTF-16 sequence or throw the same exception class. The separate exhaustive JVM oracle requires a normal return with the exact CSV characters.
assume: (input.length() < 1 || input.charAt(0) == 97 || input.charAt(0) == 44 || input.charAt(0) == 34 || input.charAt(0) == 13 || input.charAt(0) == 10) && (input.length() < 2 || input.charAt(1) == 97 || input.charAt(1) == 44 || input.charAt(1) == 34 || input.charAt(1) == 13 || input.charAt(1) == 10) && (input.length() < 3 || input.charAt(2) == 97 || input.charAt(2) == 44 || input.charAt(2) == 34 || input.charAt(2) == 13 || input.charAt(2) == 10)
